summary: 34 images are visually related but are not a structurally consistent sprite set. Earlier style acceptance did not establish common cell spacing, common frame geometry or preserved eye readability.
methodLimits: Qualitative visual audit only; exact interval and frame-coordinate measurement belongs to root audit.
Large monochrome rectangles can be merged cells and alone do not prove a larger base grid.
All landmarks are rough manual estimates in current low canvas, not numerical detections. They must be checked after transformation.
referenceCaveat: player1 and artoria are style references, not structural exemptions; they themselves have mixed-looking subdivision and different frame/corner proportions.

recommendedConstruction.frame: One immutable high-resolution frame1 master composited identically onto every portrait.

landmarkTargets.notes: Targets guide composition rather than erase age/sex/body proportions. Crown/hat/hair is not face size. Preserve true eye covering; permit accessories to crop instead of shrinking face. For eye-less lows restore eye cells from high-quality original landmarks, not invented uncovered eyes.

partialExceptions.liao: Only patched eye exempt; other eye visible.
partialExceptions.terracotta: Clay eye grooves rather than human pupils.
